ApiKeyAuth.description:
Use your API key as the username and leave the password blank.

Example:
Authorization: Basic <base64(apiKey:)>

OrdNumber.description: Order number is the subscription ID of the line

OrdLine.description: Order line is the origin or addon line id of the charge line

ConfirmDate.description: Confirm Date captures the contract's effective date for system processing and allocation

SellPrice.description: Sell Price is the total sale value of the contract line

ListPrice.description: The list price is the price of the subscription/item before the discount and coupons

Currency.description: The currency in which the subscription is billed

CompanyCurrency.description: Company Currency is the base or company currency for the entity, which is required if it differs from the transaction currency

CExRate.description: The Company Exchange Rate is the exchange rate between the transaction currency and the entity currency, which is required if they are different currencies

GExRate.description: The Global/Reporting Exchange Rate is the exchange rate between the entity currency and the reporting currency which is required if they are different currencies

StartDate.description: The Start Date represents the beginning of the service term (if applicable) for the contract line item. This date is used for allocation over time

EndDate.description: The End Date represents the end of the service term (if applicable) for the contract line item. This date is used for allocation over time

DeliveryDate.description: The Delivery Date represents the delivery date of the item

Quantity.description: Quantity of the item sold on the order line

Term.description: Term identifies the number of billing or service units associated with the order line, based on the source system contract structure.

Duration.description: Duration of the service/contract in months

SSP.description: Standalone Selling Price is the fair value to use for the contract line's allocation when an SSP from outside the Recurly RevRec system is required

CV.description: CV is the carve-out value or adjusted allocation value used when a line requires a specific allocation treatment.

Item.description: Item is the name or SKU of the contract line item

Customer.description: Customer is the name of the end-customer associated with the subscription

DRAccount.description: This field holds the Dr Account, which would be the liability account for a revenue line. If this value is not included, the Recurly RevRec system will default to the Liability account of the associated sales order/contract line

CRAccount.description: This field holds the Cr Account.For a revenue line, this would be the revenue account. For a cost line, this would be the COGS account

BaseAmount.description: The baseAmount is used for lines where only a portion of the Sell Price should be used for allocation. Any Sell Price amount above the baseAmount for this line will be considered an overage by Recurly RevRec and recognized point in time

ExpectedRnwl.description: Expected renewal represents the estimated renewal amount or renewal indicator associated with the order line.

Company.description: Company identifies the legal entity, business unit, or company code associated with the order line.

ObjectType.description: Object Type identifies the source object classification for the order line record.

Allocation.description: The Allocation element identifies whether a line is eligible to participate in the allocation of revenue across a revenue arrangement

RightToBill.description: Right To Bill identifies whether billing rights have been established for the order line.

ProcessedFlag.description: Indicates the current state of doc line

OrdNumber.description: The Sales Order Number of the associated sales order/contract line that is critical to reference the bill line to a contract.

OrdLine.description: The Sales Order Line of the associated sales order/contract line that is critical to reference the bill line to a contract.

DocType.description: The Doc Type identifies the bill line as a particular invoice or credit line, and it determines the action the Recurly RevRec system will perform on the line.

DocNumber.description: This is commonly the invoice or credit memo number. The combination of Doc Line + Doc Number must be unique for each bill line in Recurly RevRec

DocLine.description: This is commonly the invoice or credit memo line. The combination of Doc Line + Doc Number must be unique for each bill line in Recurly RevRec

DocDate.description: Doc Date is the invoice or credit memo date that is used to record the liability balance in the Recurly RevRec system

RefDocNumber.description: For credit memo lines, the Reference Doc Number is the invoice number with which the credit memo is associated. This value is critical to link a credit memo to its parent invoice.

RefDocLine.description: For credit memo lines, the Reference Doc Line is the invoice line with which the credit memo is associated. This value is critical to link a credit memo to its parent invoice

Amount.description: The Amount is the key element to be posted and represents the total value of the doc line

Quantity.description: Quantity of the item sold on the bill line

Currency.description: Currency is the transaction currency for the bill line

CompanyCurrency.description: Company Currency is the base or company currency for the entity, which is required if it differs from the transaction currency.

CExRate.description: The Company Exchange Rate is the exchange rate between the transaction currency and the entity currency, which is required if they are different currencies

GExRate.description: The Global/Reporting Exchange Rate is the exchange rate between the entity currency and the reporting currency which is required if they are different currencies

StartDate.description: The Start Date represents the beginning of the service term (if applicable) for the bill line item

EndDate.description: The End Date represents the end of the service term (if applicable) for the bill line item

DRAccount.description: This field holds the Debit Account for the invoice line.

CRAccount.description: This field holds the Credit Account for the invoice line.

CreditRule.description: The Credit Rule is only applicable for credit memo lines, and it determines how the system will apply the credit amount to revenue

ObjectType.description: Object Type identifies the source object classification for the document line record.

CanceledBill.description: Canceled Bill indicates whether the document line represents a cancellation or reversal of a previously billed line.

AutoBill.description: Auto Bill indicates whether the billing record was generated automatically by the source workflow or system.

OrdNumber.description: The Sales Order Number of the associated sales order/contract line is critical to reference the cost to a contract

costTypeID.description: Cost Type ID associates the cost line with a Cost Type configured in Recurly RevRec

costID.description: Cost ID is unique identifier for the given cost type. It could be mapped to any extended fields like Sales Representative Name. If nothing is provided one cost line per one cost type is allowed

OrdLine.description: The Sales Order Line of the associated sales order/contract line is critical to reference the cost to a contract

Amount.description: The Cost Amount is the key element to be posted, and represents the total value of the cost line

Currency.description: Cost Currency is the transaction currency for the cost line

CompanyCurrency.description: Company Currency is the base or company currency for the entity, which is required if it defers from the transaction currency

CExRate.description: The Company exchange Rate is the exchange rate between the transaction currency and the entity currency, which is required if they are different currencies

GExRate.description: The Global/Reporting Exchange Rate is the exchange rate between the entity currency and the reporting currency which is required if they are different currencies

StartDate.description: The start date represents the start of the service term (if applicable) for the cost line item

EndDate.description: The end date represents the end of the service term (if applicable) for the cost line item. This date is used for allocation over time

DRAccount.description: This field holds the Dr Account, which would be the DCOGS account for a COGS line

CRAccount.description: This field holds the Cr Account, which would be the Recognized Cost account for a Cost line.

ObjectType.description: Object Type identifies the source object classification for the cost line record.

OrdNumber.description: The Sales Order number of the targeted sales order/contract line for the action of the business event.

OrdLine.description: The Sales Order Line number of the targeted sales order/contract line for the action business event.

EventAction.description: Action defines the treatment that the Recurly RevRec system will apply to the targeted item using the business event attributes.

AccountMethod.description: The revenue method controls how over time revenue is calculated per period. (This is an optional field that is available for advanced use cases; revMethod is usually controlled through performance obligation configuration.)

Value.description: Value is the numeric amount, percentage, or quantity applied by the event, depending on the selected Value Type.

StartDate.description: The Start Date field can be used in conjunction with End Date and revMethod to recognize a particular amount of the targeted revenue line over time between two dates (e.g. recognize $20 between Start Date and End Date calculated Daily).

EndDate.description: The end date represents the end of the event.

ReleaseDate.description: The release date is the date that the action will be applied to the targeted item. Unlike effective date, the action will be applied immediately to dates in future accounting periods as well (i.e. in waterfall reports).

ExpireDate.description: The Expire Date is used for events meant to update the expiry date of a referenced revenue hold.

EffectiveDate.description: The effective date is used when the business event should not be applied until a future period. Events with an effect date in a future accounting period will not apply any actions to a targeted line until that period is opened in the system

Account.description: This field holds the Cr Account. For a revenue line, this would be the revenue account. For a cost line, this would be the COGS account

Comments.description: Comments stores free-form notes or business context associated with the event.

parameters.name: bookId
parameters.description: Book ID is the ID for the book to be included in the requested report.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the upload to show in the UI. Passed as URL parameter

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: Name of the upload File. Passed as URL parameter.

entityName.description: Entity Name filters or labels the specific entity, layout target, or config item for the requested report.

reportId.description: Report ID identifies the kind of report being requested.

reportType.description: Report Type identifies the kind of line data to include in the requested report.

bookId.description: Book ID is the ID for the book to be included in the requested report

netType.description: Net Type determines whether the report should present gross values, net values, or another supported balance basis.

currencyType.description: Currency Type identifies the currency that should be used for the requested reports.

download.description: True will return all data by compressing the csv file. false will return csv file with first 1000 rows( mainly used for validation)

periodId.description: Period ID identifies the accounting period in which to run the requested report. For waterfall reports, this will be the ending period of the requested report.

fieldConfigId.description: Field Config ID identifies the report field definition used in the saved layout filter or prompt.

value.description: Value is the user-selected filter or prompt value for the corresponding layout field.

indicator.description: Indicator controls field behavior in the layout, such as search, grouping, or other supported flags.

waterFallType.description: Waterfall Type determines if requested waterfall report should include actuals, forecast, or both.

summarized.description: Summarized indicates whether the report should return summarized output instead of detailed transaction-level rows.

parameters.name: periodId
parameters.description: Period ID identifies the accounting period for which the transfer batches are requested
